faq.answer: Pritam is a full-stack engineer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web applications with React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js, and TypeScript, including work on live fintech and e-learning platforms.

faq.question: What is his current role?

faq.question: How much experience does he have?
